sentences.text:
The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in case Fir No.
649/2021, under Sections 406/498A/34 of the Ipc, registered at P.S. Naraina.

2. It is pointed out by learned counsel for the applicant that during the pendency of the present
application, chargesheet in the present case has been filed before the court of competent
jurisdiction.

3.  In view of the above, learned counsel for the applicant seeks to withdraw the present application,
with liberty to move an application seeking regular bail before the learned Trial Court.
4.
5. The application is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
This is a digitally signed order.
